agreement.title: Publication Agreement
agreement.body:
By signing, you agree to the Society's terms for publishing your work, from the Policy Manual:

9.1 Creators own their work. By presenting or submitting it, they give the Society permission to show, perform, publish and archive it for the purpose agreed, and nothing more.

9.2 Everyone who works on a Society project is credited by name in its programme, masthead or end credits, unless they ask not to be.

9.5 Plagiarism in any Society programme leads to withdrawal of the work and may lead to action under P1.

10.1 Creative work submitted to Society programmes (Waraq, the Prizes, Scratch Night, the Typewriter Tour) must be the member’s own. Work drafted, written, translated or generated by AI is not eligible. Spellcheck and basic grammar tools are fine.

The purpose agreed is publication in Waraq, online and in print, and the Society's archive.

about.title: About the Society
about.lede: To cultivate a culture of literature and creative expression across AUIB.
about.preamble: We, students of the American University of Iraq – Baghdad, gathered as the Society of Arts and Letters, in a city that once kept the House of Wisdom and still keeps al-Mutanabbi Street, adopt this Constitution so that our Society is open to every student, governed in the open, careful with people and money, and built to outlast those who founded it.

open.title: Open and free
open.body: Any enrolled AUIB student can join. No fee, no audition, no portfolio. Members who take part in two activities a semester vote.

power.title: Members hold the power
power.body: The General Assembly of all members elects the officers, changes this Constitution and can remove anyone who abuses a role.

council.body: Four elected officers and six appointed directors meet every two weeks, adopt the budget and greenlight programs.

elections.body: Secret ballot with AUIB sign-in, run by a committee of non-candidates. Ranked choice when more than two stand. Presidents serve two terms at most.

process.title: Fair process
process.body: Anyone facing discipline hears the concern and can answer it. Removal of an officer needs two-thirds of members voting.

last.title: Written to last
last.body: Minutes, reports and an archive are kept for the next generation. Core principles can only be changed at two meetings, a month apart.

about.nonPartisan: Our Society is non-partisan and non-sectarian. Your writing and art can explore anything human. The Society itself takes no side in party or sect.

privacy.title: Privacy and photo policy
privacy.lede: How the Society treats your data and your image, from the Policy Manual, and how this website handles your information.

p.5_1: Anyone clearly featured in Society video or photography, or in an interview, signs a release before publication. Guests see their episode or feature before it is released.
p.5_2: At every event, a notice says that photography is taking place. Anyone may wear a camera-shy sticker or ask not to be photographed; photographers respect this without question.
p.5_3: Anyone may ask for a photo or video of themselves to be removed. The Society takes it down within 24 hours, no reasons needed.
p.5_4: Crowd photographs are fine; close-ups of individuals who have not agreed are not published.
p.5_5: Photographs of people praying, in distress or in private moments are not taken.
p.6_1: The Society collects only what it needs: name, AUIB email, college, year, phone (optional), and attendance. It never collects ID numbers or bank details.
p.6_2: Member data lives in the restricted Members folder, seen only by the officers, the Director of Membership and the Records Lead.
p.6_3: Member data is never shared outside the Society or used for anything other than Society business, including campaigning in Society elections.
p.6_4: Members may ask to see or delete their data at any time. Data of members who leave is deleted one year after they leave, except their name and roles in the archive.
p.6_5: Submissions, ballots and conduct records follow their own retention rules: Waraq's guidelines, B6.11 and B10.8.

partners.title: Partners
partners.lede: The clubs, departments and organizations the AUIB Society of Arts and Letters works with. Every partnership listed here has a signed memorandum.
partners.empty: Our first partnerships are being agreed. They will appear here once signed.
partners.work: The Society partners with clubs, departments, charities and cultural organizations whose aims fit its mission and who treat people fairly. Sponsors are acknowledged and never have editorial influence. Write to the Director of Partnerships through the contact page.

verify.title: Check a certificate or a card
verify.lede: Certificates from the AUIB Society of Arts and Letters carry a code and a QR at the foot; membership cards carry a QR that changes every 30 seconds. Scan one, or type a code, to see whether it stands.
verify.invalid: That doesn't look like a certificate or card code.
verify.notFound: No certificate has this code. Check it and try again.
verify.valid: This certificate was issued by the Society and stands.
verify.signedBy: Signed on this website by the President and the Faculty Advisor.
verify.pattern: This certificate's pattern. It should match the one printed on the certificate.

verifyCard.title: Membership card
verifyCard.lede: The membership cards of the AUIB Society of Arts and Letters carry a code that leads here. This page says whose card it is and whether the membership stands today.
verifyCard.notFound: No card has this code. It may have been replaced by a newer one.
verifyCard.lapsed: This card belongs to the Society's records, but the membership does not stand today.
verifyCard.note: Members can replace their card's code at any time; an old code then stops working.
verifyCard.live: This is the live card: its code is from the last minute.
verifyCard.notLive: This code isn't live (it may be a screenshot). Ask to see the card on the member's own phone.
verifyCard.perks: Partners: this member may use the Society's member perks.
verifyCard.pattern: This card's pattern. It should match the one on the member's card.

productions.title: The Company
productions.lede: Staged readings and productions by the AUIB Society of Arts and Letters, with partners and other AUIB clubs.
productions.empty: Our first productions are in the works. They will appear here once announced.

games.title: Games
games.lede: A word guess and a word search every day, and crosswords and word searches from Qirtas's editors.
games.today: The daily games change at midnight, Baghdad time. Your progress stays in this browser.
games.none: No puzzles from the editors yet.
games.guessLede: Find the five-letter word in six tries.
games.aiMade: Made with an AI tool from facts published on auibsal.org.

guess.howTo: A dark square is the right letter in the right place. A tinted square is in the word, somewhere else.

search.notAWord: No word there. Choose its first letter again.
search.howTo: Choose the first letter of a word, then its last. Words run across, down or diagonally.

crossword.howTo: Type in the squares. Choose a clue, or the same square twice, to change direction.

newsletter.title: The Month in Qirtas
newsletter.lede: One email a month, on the 1st: the pieces Qirtas published that month and the AUIB Society of Arts and Letters' coming public events. Anyone can subscribe.
newsletter.members: Members also get the Sunday Paper, a weekly email of the week's pieces.
newsletter.sent: Check your inbox: we sent a link to confirm. Nothing else arrives until you do.
newsletter.fineprint: We use your address only for this email. Every email has a link to unsubscribe.

errors.invalid_email: That address cannot receive email. Check it and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Try again later.

confirm.title: Confirm your subscription
confirm.lede: Press the button to start receiving The Month in Qirtas.
confirm.done: You are subscribed. The next email arrives on the 1st of the month.
confirm.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Subscribe again to get a new one.
confirm.failed: Something went wrong. Try again later.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.lede: Press the button to stop receiving The Month in Qirtas.
unsubscribe.done: You are unsubscribed. You will not get another email from us.
unsubscribe.failed: Something went wrong. Try again later.

governance.electionsEmpty: Results appear here once the Elections Committee publishes them.

personalEmail.title: Confirm your personal email
personalEmail.lede: Press the button to confirm this address as your personal email with the AUIB Society of Arts and Letters.
personalEmail.done: Confirmed. The Society will use this address after you graduate.
personalEmail.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Send a new one from Profile.
personalEmail.in_use: This address is already someone's, so it can't be confirmed. Use another one in Profile.
personalEmail.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

stopEmails.title: Stop Society emails
stopEmails.lede: Press the button to stop the Sunday Paper and the reminders for events you booked. Emails about your own requests, work and account still come.
stopEmails.done: Done. You can turn them back on in Settings.
stopEmails.failed: Something went wrong. Try again later.
